Expeditions

Goto Terminal Survey

Documenting the environment beneath the terminals

Explore the work

ProjectsResearchExpeditionsDiscuss a project

Location: Goto terminals, Bonaire.

Year: 2026.

Client: Rijkswaterstaat.

My role: underwater photogrammetry, imagery processing, inspection software, and technical reporting.

I conducted underwater surveys beneath the Goto terminals to document marine debris and reef condition. The assignment carried through from collecting imagery to producing maps, reconstructions, and tools for inspecting the results.

The field assignment

The survey created a visual record of the underwater environment beneath the terminals. Photogrammetry provided the basis for reconstructing and mapping the surveyed areas.

Survey outputs

I processed the imagery into 3D reconstructions and orthomosaics and prepared technical reports documenting coverage and survey outputs.

To support inspection, I also built a scan viewer and labeling tool that enabled Rijkswaterstaat to review the imagery and analyze debris.

Explore the inspection tool

Goto Survey Viewer: how the imagery becomes a tool for inspection and labeling.
